title: EBI-Metagenomics/wdp pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet used by the wdp pipeline (Slice 1: gTranslate -> CheckM2 -> gemsparcl)

accession.errorMessage: Accession must be a versioned GCA/GCF accession (e.g. GCA_000006625.1) -- must match the basename of the fasta file exactly, since downstream tools (CheckM2, gTranslate, GUNC) derive each genome's ID from its fasta filename with only the .fasta.gz suffix stripped

fasta.errorMessage: FASTA file must exist and end in .fasta.gz (wdp's genomes are always gzipped -- note this deliberately differs from mettannotator's uncompressed .fa/.fna/.fasta convention)

taxid.errorMessage: taxid is required for the taxid_codon_cache lookup

known_ttable.description: Optional per-genome codon table override (e.g. a hand-curated test row for a known table-4 genome). Leave empty to fall through to the taxid_codon_cache_tsv lookup, then gTranslate if still unresolved. Mirrors mettannotator's optional-column-skips-a-step pattern (gene_calls_gff/annotation_source).
